changelog: Sync concept generation through the API and CLI, turning a recipe and brief into a musical direction grounded in your plugin catalog.
Claude Fable 5.1 in the model picker, with high-effort reasoning.
Greybeard finds its service when another app occupies port 3000, and keeps checking if the service starts late without freezing the plugin window.
Update notifications refresh after 30 minutes so long-running sessions can discover new releases.
Installing an upgrade stops the old installed service so the next plugin load starts the updated code.
Updated the SQLite binding to prevent database cleanup crashes on Node 24.
